be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng Mervat 
Mahmoud El Said, tested at 12 March 2004, by eng. Hamdi Mahmoud Ismael at 
Heliopolis
substation, accepted by 
eng. Ahmed Faisal Shelabi General Director, and approved by eng. Samir Saleh 
Ismael ;Extra high voltage Cairo Sector, Cairo Zone.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
the suitable safety category.

Wear the 
 appropriate 
 personal protective tools, safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 ...etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker and 
 ground it.

Change remote/local control switch 
 to local position.

Set of 
 common tools, keys, screw drivers,
Cleaning cloths, SF6 gas and machine.
Air blower.
Clean all insulators and mechanism.
Clean local cabinet by dry air, retighten all connections.

Lubricate the moving parts of the breaker, which connected the mechanism 
 parts.

Inspect the contact surface "lower & upper" and replace warm parts (if 
 necessary).
Check for any corrosion at the mating contact surface.

Check the charging spring of the breaker is recharged automatically after each 
 ON operation.

During charging spring, observe if there is any noise or spark in the charging 
 motor.

Check the auxiliary switch function by its correct position through position 
 indication and check mechanism position indicators.
Check the position indication of the earthing switch.
Inspect the vacuum bottles.
Check the contact resistance and timing switch of the circuit breaker.
Record the number of operations from CB counter.

Close the work order and inform shift engineer that the circuit breaker is 
 ready to be in service.

Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to 
be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng Mervat 
Mahmoud El Said, tested at 12 March 2004, by eng. Hamdi Mahmoud Ismael at 
Heliopolis
substation, accepted by 
eng. Ahmed Faisal Shelabi General Director, and approved by eng. Samir Saleh 
Ismael ;Extra high voltage Cairo Sector, Cairo Zone.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
the suitable safety category.
Wear the 
 appropriate 
 personal protective tools, safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 ...etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker and 
 ground it.
Change remote/local control switch 
 to local position.
Tools and Equipment
Set of 
 common tools, keys, screw drivers,
Cleaning cloths, SF6 gas and machine.
Air blower.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean all insulators and mechanism.
Clean local cabinet by dry air, retighten all connections.
Lubricate the moving parts of the breaker, which connected the mechanism 
 parts.
Inspect the contact surface "lower & upper" and replace warm parts (if 
 necessary).
Check for any corrosion at the mating contact surface.
Check the charging spring of the breaker is recharged automatically after each 
 ON operation.
During charging spring, observe if there is any noise or spark in the charging 
 motor.
Check the auxiliary switch function by its correct position through position 
 indication and check mechanism position indicators.
Check the position indication of the earthing switch.
Inspect the vacuum bottles.
Check the contact resistance and timing switch of the circuit breaker.
Record the number of operations from CB counter.
Close the work order and inform shift engineer that the circuit breaker is 
 ready to be in service.
